facts.fact: Data Center POST reports on 2024-09-11 that ST Digital's DLA01 data center in Douala, a carrier-neutral facility serving clients and housing the DOUALA-IX exchange, achieved Open-IX DC OIX-2 certification.

Data Center POST describes ST Digital's DLA01 in Douala as the first carrier-neutral, tier 3-built data center in Central Africa (operator's own description; no Uptime or TIA-942 certification named; it holds Open-IX DC OIX-2).
